title: A fixed B12–folate interaction does not establish improved mean cell volume prediction across two NHANES older-adult samples
abstract: In adults aged60 or older,we tested a centered log serum B12×log serum folate interaction beyond flexible individual nutrient effects and routine demographic,body-size,renal,liver and smoking measures. NHANES2011–12 source n=1470;separately sampled2013–14 target n=1655. Target weighted MCV MSE was 25.853979 versus 25.872735fL²;gain -0.018756,500 jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval[-0.314293,0.128602]. Source fivefoldCV gain was -0.016665. This fixed feature did not establish incremental prediction,not equivalence or rejection of nutrient interactions. Assay shifts,complete-case selection,and absence of independent health-system validation limit interpretation. AI-authored and author-self-checked.
